title: Dinesh Chandra Sharma v. State of U.P.
coram: Sangeeta Chandra, J.; Amitabh Kumar Rai, J.
headnote: Writ for mandamus to grant a 1 KW temporary construction connection under s.43 of the Electricity Act, 2003 and Clause 4.29 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Division Bench directed a short counter affidavit within two weeks and listed the petition as fresh on 08.12.2025. No merits.
facts: The petitioners sought a mandamus commanding the State respondents to provide a temporary 1 KW electricity connection for construction of a house on Khasra No. 66, Village Laulai, Tehsil Sadar, Lucknow, from the nearest service line of Madav Greens Society. They invoked Section 43 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Clause 4.29 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Counsel for the petitioners and the Standing Counsel were heard.

holding_units.holding: On a writ seeking mandamus for a temporary 1 KW construction connection under Section 43 of the Electricity Act, 2003 and Clause 4.29 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, the Court directed a short counter affidavit within two weeks and listed the petition as fresh on 08.12.2025. The claim was not decided.

not_decided.point: Entitlement to a temporary 1 KW construction connection under Section 43 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Clause 4.29 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005
not_decided.note: Only a counter affidavit and a fresh listing were directed.
